events.description: At sea at 4:00 a.m. between Melbourne and Sydney, Australia, the two sons of the Prince of Wales, one of them the future king of England, were cruising aboard “La Bacchante” when a flying object resembling a fully lighted ship was seen, “a phantom vessel all aglow.”
